description: Imperial plum floor-length court gown over a cream linen underdress, with low square neckline, fitted opaque bodice, elbow sleeves and gold woven borders at straps, neckline, waist, cuffs, front and hem. Round jeweled gold clasps fasten upper straps and belt. A cream wrap with plum-gold borders rests on the arms; earrings, bracelet, rings and dark decorated flats complete the outfit.
